checks.finding: Native enum initializer constructs QWERTY and assigns N1 (offset0x929), constructs ROMAJI and assigns x4 (offset0x2128). PredictionSearchType.NORMAL is a native public enum value verified by the runtime owner.

Existing JapaneseGlidePatch inserts its handler immediately before virtual f(token,event). The native xd0/f0 class inherits onTouchEvent; hook routing contains no layout/language filter before the handler. Reusing this hook admits English through the same path.

ACTION_CANCEL is a separate branch at offset 0x22: iterates native pointer keys and calls tj0/e.E, then tj0/e.D and ef0/n.f. It does not take the ordinary UP branch at 0x1d7. FlickSymbols sends CANCEL through f0.f directly and keeps swallowing the owned stream.

History API is shared: ec0/x.G selects composing ec0/f or noncomposing ec0/o. Both ec0/o text methods return the empty string. ec0/f initializes text to empty string and exposes composition/raw text; the snapshot is not a Japanese-only API.

No layout or PredictionSearchType gate. xc0/i creates fc0/d1 with the single-character flag true and registers the native long-press release action. Popup path creates e60/b with provider tag 7 and registers fc0/b1 activation. English can reuse exactly the existing resolver.

Configured popup characters are copied before nonduplicate language-specific variants are appended. The common popup builder decides direct vs multi-choice based on candidate count and native settings. The repair must reuse native popup default index, not hardcode symbols or the first accent.
Both ordinary character popup entry points pass true,true for the two booleans used to construct fb0/l2. Those flags are shared across languages and match the existing resolver checks.

Production diff admits QWERTY+NORMAL and ROMAJI+NORMAL while retaining ROMAJI+JAPANESE. Each stroke snapshots exact enum identities, so switching between two supported modes also abandons insertion. Password/numeric, selection, tool type, geometry, popup, actor identity, editor and connection exclusions are unchanged.

limitations: Live English Flow recognition timing and UI are not exercised by the host doubles.
ROMAJI+NORMAL is intentionally accepted for alphabetic-mode transitions; no claim that every target configuration emits this combination.
Direct actor and popup defaults remain controlled by the installed native layout and settings.

native_layout_resources.finding: The serialized native layout resources share 2801 leading bytes, including q/1 and a/@ label/alternate fields. This is corroborating byte-level evidence, not a full layout parser or a live keyboard trace.

scope: Independent source and native DEX/resource inspection; native execution remains unverified.
